definitions.gloss: one after another; in succession; successively
definitions.explanation: Events or actions occurring in rapid sequence, one following closely after another. Often implies an unexpected or noteworthy series of occurrences.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}が{相次|あいつ}いで{起|お}きた。
{新|あたら}しい{店|みせ}が{相次|あいつ}いでオープンしている。
examples.english: New shops are opening one after another.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}{企業|きぎょう}が{相次|あいつ}いで{不祥事|ふしょうじ}を{起|お}こし、{社会|しゃかい}{問題|もんだい}になった。
examples.english: Major companies caused scandals one after another, becoming a social problem.

notes:
USAGE:
{相次|あいつ}いで is the te-form of the verb {相次|あいつ}ぐ, functioning as an adverb. It is commonly used in news reports and formal writing to describe a series of events happening in quick succession. The plain verb form {相次|あいつ}ぐ is also used as a modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相次|あいつ}いで{発生|はっせい}する (to occur in succession)
- {相次|あいつ}いで{報告|ほうこく}される (to be reported one after another)
- {相次|あいつ}ぐ{事件|じけん} (a series of incidents)

RELATED WORDS:
- {次々|つぎつぎ}に: one after another (more casual)
- {続々|ぞくぞく}と: one after another, in droves
- {立|た}て{続|つづ}けに: in rapid succession
